card.title: The Impossible Promise
card.instruction: Treat an old, seemingly impossible promise as fully binding, and interpret every delay as unfinished business rather than release.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've set a plate for that guest from next century you promised last Christmas.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They can't arrive for another hundred years. We should eat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Go ahead. I'll keep their dinner warm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The oven won't last a hundred years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the replacement needs a warming drawer. Your guest is still expected.

mechanism: A treats the promised future guest as still expected and plans ongoing meal infrastructure instead of accepting the century delay as cancellation.
confusable: Unlike general hopeful prediction, A relies on a specific old promise and treats new obstacles as maintenance of that obligation.
comparison: The guest alternative extends the obligation into buying a suitable oven; the sunrise alternative preserves an empty shelf against other purchases.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
